goals.title: Complete coding factory Phase 1 POC
goals.why: This proves autonomous engineering is real. A system that writes, tests, and ships code without a human is the future.
goals.progress: Phases 1–6 complete: task intake, worktree isolation, code execution, agent integration, autonomous loop, result validation, feedback loop, multi-repo orchestration. Added a config-driven CLI entrypoint (redteam-factory) for production-ish runs.
goals.nextAction: Document CLI usage + add example factory.config.json/tasks.json templates; then wire into RedTeam CI/CD runbook.

goals.progress: Resolved TICKET-20260224-024 (schema validator) and TICKET-20260224-035 (config keys). Most remaining tickets are infrastructure/sandbox limitations or consolidated duplicates.
